headline: COPPER HITS RECORD $6.54/LB — BUT THE REAL SQUEEZE IS A 17-YEAR WAIT FOR NEW MINES
snippet: With copper at $6.54/lb on a near-record pace, a major structural analysis warns the real crisis is downstream: bringing a new copper mine from discovery to production now takes an average of 17 years, meaning projects greenlit today won't produce until the early 2040s — years after demand for EV motors and grid wiring peaks.

headline: HELIOSTAR METALS HITS 52.4M AT 5.84 G/T GOLD AT ANA PAULA — HIGH GRADE PANEL AND EXPANSION ZONE BOTH GROW
snippet: Heliostar Metals (TSX-V) reported 52.4 metres grading 5.84 g/t gold from the High Grade Panel at Ana Paula in Guerrero, Mexico, simultaneously extending the Expansion Zone as the company advances toward a feasibility study.

headline: MACKAY GOLD & SILVER DRILLS 67.1M AT 2.30 G/T IN NEVADA'S COMSTOCK DISTRICT — 550M STRIKE ZONE TRACED
snippet: Mackay Gold & Silver (OTC: MKGSF) released its second batch of Occidental South assays from the historic Comstock District in Nevada, returning 67.1 metres at 2.30 g/t gold and tracing a continuous gold-bearing zone across 550 metres of strike length.

headline: SELKIRK COPPER DRILLS 44.7M AT 2.12% COPPER AT MINTO NORTH — YUKON HIGH-GRADE INFILL TIGHTENS GRID
snippet: Phase 2 infill drilling at Selkirk Copper's Minto North project in the Yukon returned 44.7 metres grading 2.12% copper, 1.16 g/t gold, and 10.7 g/t silver, tightening the drill grid ahead of an anticipated resource update at the former producing mine.

headline: TECTONIC METALS DRILLS 2.41 G/T GOLD OVER 59.44M IN ALASKA — ALPHA BOWL ADDS NEAR-SURFACE OUNCES AT FLAT GOLD
snippet: Tectonic Metals (TSX-V: TECT) reported 19 drill holes from Alpha Bowl at the Flat Gold Project in southwest Alaska, with the headline intercept of 2.41 g/t Au over 59.44 metres extending near-surface gold mineralization and building out the ounce base in a region attracting renewed major-company interest.

headline: GREENLAND PARLIAMENT VOTES TO BAN SEABED MINING UNTIL 2029 — DEFIES TRUMP MINERAL PUSH
snippet: Greenland's parliament unanimously passed a non-binding proposal directing the government to draft a law banning deep-sea mining and exploration until at least 2029, one day after President Trump publicly announced plans for oil, gas, and mineral exploitation on the island — a direct regulatory counterpoint to US critical minerals ambitions.

headline: VALE WARNS: RISING COSTS PUT 10% OF IRON ORE OUTPUT IN LOSS TERRITORY AS CHINA DEMAND FADES
snippet: Vale disclosed that approximately 10% of its iron ore production is now cash-flow negative as all-in costs surge and Chinese steel demand deteriorates, pushing spot iron ore to two-year lows — a red flag for diversified miners relying on base-metals margins to fund exploration.

headline: OCEANA METALS CLOSES SERRA NEGRA DEAL IN BRAZIL — FOUR DIAMOND RIGS DRILL TOWARD FIRST RESOURCE
snippet: Oceana Metals (ASX: OCN) completed its acquisition of the Serra Negra polymetallic project in Brazil for US$2.95 million cash plus 15.5 million shares, with four diamond drill rigs immediately mobilised toward an initial NI 43-101 resource estimate.

headline: CENTINELA COPPER STRIKE ENTERS DAY 12 WITH HUNGER STRIKE — NOVEMBER OUTPUT COULD BE CUT BY HALF
snippet: Negotiations at Antofagasta's Centinela copper mine in Chile remain deadlocked as 709 striking workers escalate to a hunger strike, with unions warning that the full production impact arrives in November when output could fall by 50% — adding fresh upside risk to copper's already tight supply picture.

headline: SP ANGEL MONDAY MARKET VIEW: OIL RALLY PRESSURES GOLD AS COPPER HOLDS KEY LEVELS — OCT 28 FED DOMINATES
snippet: SP Angel's Monday morning metals and mining briefing flags oil's surge to May highs as the key headwind for gold's safe-haven bid ahead of the October 28 Fed decision, with copper consolidating near $6.54/lb and the Centinela strike adding unresolved supply risk in the near term.
